name: @veren/admin-data-dsh-kv
description: Use when a DSH admin deployment must serve the `data` capability without an external database: it implements the AdminDatabase port over one self-declared `admin_data` storage-domain KV table (a hex-encoded composite key per record, one document each) and registers itself as the `data` provider through ctx.admin, leaving the medium (json/sqlite) to the storage group's backend routes; skip it when the deployment needs real multi-record transactions, secondary indexes, or full-text queries.
